description: Header file implementing `absl::bind_front()` functionality, defining the FrontBinder class template for binding arguments to functions.

classes.name: FrontBinder
classes.description: Template class for binding arguments to a function, supporting various call overloads for lvalue and rvalue instances.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Template function to invoke a method with a tuple of bound arguments and additional free arguments.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Overloaded call operators in FrontBinder for invoking the bound function with additional arguments, supporting lvalue and rvalue contexts.
